timing: Frozen before RTC launch and before any received-audio ASR.
scope: All four declared whole received PCM streams, in original order; failures/unavailable rows remain in the denominator.
method: Pinned production LocalSTT through offline cached Parakeet on local-mac; resample entire mono PCM16 24 kHz to16 kHz with existing helper. No trimming, silence removal, retries or capture-success selection.

review.waypoint: First MG Road navigation result is intentionally interrupted; final Blue Tokai Indiranagar addition retains MG Road destination, estimate13minutes and0extra. Retain all incorrect entity/number spellings; do not normalize13and30.
review.score: Verbatim whole-stream ASR plus reviewed facts, not human listening or held-out accuracy.

limitations: Production ASR proxy cannot distinguish pronunciation from recognition errors; no human listening.
Whole-stream text does not establish word timestamps or physical playback.
Four repeated synthetic development captures share warm models and a fixed order.
Review is performed only after timed suite and owned model services have stopped. Its timings are separate from conversation latency.
note: All four full received streams; no clipping, retries or capture-success selection.
